state.complaint_text: On 2 September we instructed an urgent international payment of EUR 38,500 to our boat-parts supplier in Rotterdam. We were told it would arrive same day. It did not arrive until 9 September. During that week we called your business line four times and were told each time that it was 'with the payments team' and nobody could give us a reference or a reason. Because the payment was late, our supplier applied their contractual late-payment penalty of EUR 1,150 and put our account with them on hold, which delayed a customer order. We were also charged your EUR 45 'urgent payment' fee even though the payment was clearly not urgent in practice. We want the fee refunded and the supplier penalty reimbursed, and we want to understand what went wrong so it does not happen again.
